def transform(grid):
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    colors=set(v for row in grid for v in row)
    for color in colors:
        pts={(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v==color}
        # Extend any diagonal run: from each oriented neighboring pair, continue in that direction.
        for dr,dc in ((1,1),(1,-1),(-1,1),(-1,-1)):
            for r,c in list(pts):
                if (r-dr,c-dc) in pts and (r+dr,c+dc) not in pts:
                    rr,cc=r+dr,c+dc
                    while 0<=rr<h and 0<=cc<w and grid[rr][cc]==grid[0][0]:
                        out[rr][cc]=color
                        rr+=dr;cc+=dc
    return out

# pair1 verification
